sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Generated type hints for Next
sections.what: Tells the editor about Next.js types, image handling and the app's routes.
sections.why: The file's note says it is generated and should not be edited.
sections.watch_out: Changes made by hand are lost on the next build.

summary: A generated file that gives the editor type hints for Next.js features.
purpose: Helps the editor and type checker understand Next.js routes and image types.
why: The file's own note says it should not be edited, so it is generated by Next.js.
how: Next.js writes and updates this file. Nothing in it should be changed by hand.
inputs: None from the developer. Next.js produces it.
outputs: Type definitions used by the editor and the type checker.
risks: Any hand edits are overwritten the next time Next.js runs.
debug: If route type errors appear, run the dev server or a build so Next.js regenerates the file.
